_comment: Real pools the DonationStreamer donates into, plus a couple carried purely for chain coverage. Every entry is fork-tested for the donation add_liquidity signature, a full execute_many round trip, and gas against the per-stream ceiling. Add a pool by appending its address here; nothing else needs changing. status: active = has a live stream, streamed = had one, target = donations meant to move here, coverage = only to exercise another chain.
_verified: 2026-08-21. Ethereum pool read from live stream storage. Gnosis pools resolved from the Curve API (api.curve.finance/api/getPools/xdai/factory-twocrypto) with their TVL, not from stream history: completed streams are zeroed on chain and no available RPC allows the eth_getLogs range needed to recover them.

_donation: A pool can only receive a donation if its implementation exposes add_liquidity(uint256[2],uint256,address,bool). That is a property of the blueprint, published by the Curve API, so it is recorded here rather than inferred from bytecode or discovered by a reverting transaction. Vet a new pool with: uv run python scripts/pool_registry.py <chain> <address>
